blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Skills let language agents reuse experience across tasks as natural-language documents. Recent work evolves skills from interaction, but existing methods have limitations when skills evolve online. Prior methods update a skill offline from a batch of trajectories collected over many tasks. Some then adopt the new skill without any check, which can degrade the skill over time. Others keep it only if it improves performance on a held-out validation set, which is too slow and costly to run after every update. We introduce EvoGuard, a pairwise skill selector that mitigates skill degradation at low latency and cost. We first run the agent iteratively to build pools of skills and score each skill on a private test set to obtain utility labels. We pair the skills and use rejection sampling to keep only pairs with a clear utility gap. The selector is trained on the logits of two label tokens to pick the better skill. At deployment it decides in a single forward pass, which is significantly faster than evaluation on the private test set. Compared with adopting every new skill, EvoGuard improves success by 11.0% on ALFWorld, 5.9% on ScienceWorld, and 2.7% on LiveCodeBench.
blocks.zh: 技能使语言代理人能够重新利用各种任务的经验作为自然语言文件。 最近的工作从互动中演化出技能,但当技能在线演化时,现有方法有局限性. 先前的方法从通过许多任务收集的一批轨迹上更新了一种离线技能. 有些人然后在没有检查的情况下采用新技能,这可能会随着时间的推移而降低技能。 其他人只保留它,只要它在被搁置的验证套件上改进性能,每次更新后运行速度太慢,成本太高. 我们引入了EvoGuard,一种双向技能选择器,以低延迟和低成本缓解技能退化. 我们首先迭代运行代理 建立技能的集合 在每个技能在私人测试集中得分 以获得公用事业标签。 我们把技能配对,使用拒绝抽样,只保留有明显效用差距的对子. 选择者在两个标签符号的日志上接受训练,以选择更好的技能. 在部署时,它决定采用单一的前进通道,这大大快于对私人测试集的评价。 与采用每种新技能相比,EvoGuard在ALFWorld上提高了11.0%,在ScienceWorld上提高了5.9%,在LiveCode Bench上提高了2.7%.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Language agents increasingly face streams of related tasks. Solving each task from scratch wastes what earlier interactions have revealed. A skill packages such experience as a reusable natural-language document. It records procedures, decision rules, and recovery strategies. A frozen agent can then adapt through external text instead of weight updates ( Wang et al., 2024a ; Anthropic, 2025 ; Xu and Yan, 2026 ) . Recent work builds and evolves skills from interaction ( Xia et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026b ; Yao et al., 2026 ) . However, existing methods face three limitations when skills evolve online. In this setting a deployed agent updates its skill after every task.
blocks.zh: 语文人员越来越多地面临相关任务。 从零开始解决每项任务 早期的相互作用揭示的废物 技能包,例如可重复使用的自然语言文件。 它记录程序、决定规则和回收战略。 冷冻剂然后可以通过外部文本而不是重量更新来适应(Wang等人,2024a; Anthropic, 2025; 许和燕, 2026). 近期的作品从互动中积累并发展出技能(霞等,2026;杨等,2026b;姚等,2026. 然而,当技能在线发展时,现有方法面临三个限制。 在此设置中, 部署的代理在每次任务后更新其技能 。

blocks.en: Gap 1: Offline multi-trajectory evolution does not match deployment. Most methods update a skill offline from a batch of trajectories ( Xia et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026b ) . The update runs in a training phase before deployment. It analyzes trajectories from many tasks at once. A deployed agent rarely works this way. Each task arrives once and is attempted once. The next task is usually a different one. The skill must therefore be revised from a single trajectory and then reused by later tasks. SkillRise carries a skill across tasks in this way ( Yao et al., 2026 ) . However, it trains the executor jointly with skill curation and does not check individual updates.
blocks.zh: 差距一:离线多射演化不匹配部署. 多数方法从一批出轨更新技能下线(霞等,2026;杨等,2026b.). 最新情况在部署前处于培训阶段。 它同时分析许多任务的轨迹. 部署的特工很少这样做。 每项任务一次到达,一次尝试。 下一个任务通常是不同的. 因此,技能必须从单一轨道加以修改,然后被后期任务所再利用。 SkillRise以这种方式携带了跨任务的技能(姚等,2026.). 然而,它通过技能指导对执行者进行联合培训,不检查个人更新。

blocks.en: Gap 2: Adopting every new skill causes degradation. A rewrite based on one trajectory can overfit that trajectory. A failed search may add a rule tied to one room. Even a successful episode may add redundant or misleading advice. This risk is measurable. We collect single-trajectory rewrites on ALFWorld and score every skill on a private test set of its task family (Figure 1 ).

blocks.en: Figure 1 (a) shows that the success rates of these skills spread over a wide range. Skills of very different quality therefore coexist. Figure 1 (b) shows the change in success rate after one rewrite, computed as the rewrite minus the skill it came from. The empty skill also counts as a parent. Among the 1,137 rewrites written by the base generator, 42.2% score below their parent. Another 7.7% tie, and 50.0% improve. A rewrite is thus nearly neutral on average. However, 7.7% of rewrites lose at least 10%, and 11.3% gain at least 10%. A stronger generator does not remove the problem. Of the 900 rewrites written by an expert generator, which is trained with reinforcement learning, 40.0% also score below their parent. Adopting every rewrite therefore lets the skill drift. This motivates an explicit acceptance step.
blocks.zh: 图1(a)显示,这些技能的成功率分布广泛。 因此,质量截然不同的技能共存。 图1 (b) 显示重写后成功率的变化,按重写后减去其技能计算。 空出技也算作是父母. 在基准生成器所写的1,137个重写中,42.2%的分数低于其母. 另有7.7%的平分线,50.0%的平分线改善. 因此,重写平均来说几乎是中立的。 然而,7.7%的重写至少损失了10%,11.3%的重写至少损失了10%. 更强大的发电机并不能消除问题。 在经过强化学习培训的专家发电机所写的900个重写中,40.0%的分数也低于父母。 因此,通过每回重写,就让技能漂移。 这促使采取明确接受的步骤。

blocks.en: Gap 3: Validating every update is too costly. Some methods guard against bad updates ( Alzubi et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026b ) . They keep a new skill only if it improves performance on a held-out validation set. This requires many extra rollouts for every update. Each check thus costs far more than the task that triggered the update. An online agent cannot afford this cost after every task.
blocks.zh: 差距3:验证每次更新费用太高。 一些方法防止不良更新(Alzubi等,2026;Yang等,2026b.). 他们只保留一种新技能,只要它能改进在被搁置的验证装置上的性能。 这需要为每次更新多多推出一出. 因此,每次检查的费用都远远超出导致更新的任务。 网络代理在每次任务完成后都无法承担这笔费用。

blocks.en: To address these gaps, we propose EvoGuard , a pairwise skill selector that amortizes validation. Tasks are grouped into task families, and each family keeps one skill. After each task, a fixed generator writes a new skill from the latest trajectory. EvoGuard then decides whether this new skill replaces the current skill. This decision only requires the relative order of the two skills, not their absolute utilities. We therefore cast it as a pairwise preference problem. We pay the cost of validation once before deployment and use it to train the selector. After that, each decision only compares two skill texts.
blocks.zh: 为了弥补这些差距,我们提议EvoGuard, 一个双向技能选择器, 分期偿还验证。 任务分为任务家庭,每个家庭都保留一种技能。 每次任务完成后,一个固定生成器会从最新的轨迹中写出新的技能. EvoGuard随后决定这种新技能是否取代了目前的技能. 这一决定只要求两种技能的相对顺序,而不是他们的绝对公用事业. 因此,我们把它视为一种双向偏好问题。 我们在部署前支付一次验证费用,并用来训练挑选者. 之后,每个决定只比较两个技能文本.

blocks.en: EvoGuard works in three stages (Figure 2 ). (1) Multi-source skill pool construction. We run the rewrite loop on training tasks with a base generator and an expert generator, and collect the generated skills into a pool. (2) Utility-grounded pairwise preference learning. We estimate the utility of every skill on a private test set of its family. Rejection sampling keeps pairs from the same family with a clear utility gap. We then train a pairwise selector to predict which skill in a pair has the higher utility. (3) Online skill selection. After every task, the frozen selector reads the family description and the two skills. It keeps the skill it predicts to be better. This takes one forward pass and runs no extra rollouts in the environment.
blocks.zh: EvoGuard分三个阶段工作(图2. (1)多来源技能人才库建设. 我们用一个基建发电机和一个专家发电机来重写训练任务的循环,把生成的技能收集到一个池中。 (2) 实用定位双向偏好学习。 我们估计每一套技能在私人测试中是否有用 拒绝抽样使同一家庭的对子保持明显的效用差距。 然后我们训练一个双向选择器 来预测一对中的哪一种技能有更高的效用 (3)在线技能选拔. 每次任务完成后,被冻结的选取者会阅读家庭描述和两种技能. 它保持了它预测会更好的技能. 这需要提前一次通过,并且不会在环境中进行额外的推广。

blocks.en: We evaluate EvoGuard on ALFWorld ( Shridhar et al., 2021 ) with three executors. The baselines include running without skills and adopting every new skill. They also include random selection from the skill history and three LLM-Judge variants. On skill pairs unseen during training, EvoGuard picks the better skill 95.0% of the time. Online, it outperforms every other method in all six settings. Its average success with the Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B executors is 56.5%. Adopting every new skill reaches 45.5%, and running without skills reaches 36.7%. The Qwen3-32B executor contributes no training labels. With this executor EvoGuard still reaches 69.2% against 54.9% without skills. On ScienceWorld ( Wang et al., 2022 ) , EvoGuard raises success from 10.2% to 15.3%. Our main contributions are as follows. • We formulate online skill evolution as a per-update acceptance problem. After each single-trajectory rewrite, the agent must decide whether the new skill replaces the current skill. We show that this decision matters. On ALFWorld, 42% of rewrites lower performance on a private test set. • We propose EvoGuard , a pairwise skill selector that amortizes validation. Validation runs once offline to supervise the selector. Each online decision then needs one forward pass over two skill texts. It generates no tokens and runs no extra rollouts. • EvoGuard achieves the highest success among all methods on ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, and LiveCodeBench. It also transfers to an executor unseen during selector training.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Skills package reusable experience as executable code or structured documents ( Wang et al., 2024a ; Anthropic, 2025 ; Xu and Yan, 2026 ) . Recent work evolves skills from interaction. SkillRL integrates recursive skill evolution with reinforcement learning ( Xia et al., 2026 ) . SkillOpt treats a skill as the external state of a frozen agent and optimizes it under feedback ( Yang et al., 2026b ) . SkillRise is the closest work to ours ( Yao et al., 2026 ) . It also carries an evolving skill across distinct tasks and trains the executor jointly with skill curation through reinforcement learning. However, our method keeps both the executor and the generator frozen. It only decides whether a single-trajectory rewrite should replace the current skill. This decision is learned from supervised pairwise labels without policy optimization. EvoGuard is thus a separate module that can be attached to any rewrite loop.
blocks.zh: 技能包可重复使用的经验作为可执行代码或结构文件(Wang等,2024a;Anthropic,2025;徐和燕,2026. 最近的工作从互动中演化出技能. SkillRL将再生技能进化与强化学习相融合(Xia等,2026. 技能 Opt将一技能视为被冷冻剂的外在状态,并在反馈下优化(Yang等,2026b. SkillRise是我们最接近的作品(姚等,2026. 它还具有不同任务之间不断发展的技能,并通过强化学习,对执行者进行技能辅导。 然而,我们的方法使执行者和发电机都冻结。 它只决定单轨重写是否应该取代目前的技能. 这项决定是从监督的双向标签中学习的,没有优化政策。 EvoGuard因此是一个单独的模块,可以附加在任何重写回路上.

blocks.en: Several methods check an update before they keep it. EvoSkill and SkillOpt keep an update only if it improves performance on a held-out validation set ( Alzubi et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026b ) . SkillEvo adds a governance layer that repairs degraded skills instead of only rejecting them ( Yan et al., 2026 ) . SkillEvoReg regularizes skill evolution against overfitting and tests each candidate for regressions ( Nie et al., 2026 ) . These methods execute additional tasks for every update. However, our method pays the validation cost only once before deployment. Each online decision then needs only a single forward pass over two skill texts. Other work chooses which skill to read from a library during an episode ( Li et al., 2026a ) . Our method instead decides whether a new skill should replace the current one. Appendix C discusses agent memory, learned skill writers, and further related work.
blocks.zh: 几种方法在保存之前先检查更新. EvoSkill和SkillOpt只保留更新,前提是它能改善在被搁置的验证集上的性能(Alzubi等,2026;Yang等,2026b.). 技能 Evo增加了一个治理层,修复退化的技能,而不是仅仅拒绝这些技能(Yan等人,2026年)。 技能 EvoReg将技能演化正规化,防止过度适应,并对每个考生进行回归测试(Nie等,2026年). 这些方法执行每次更新的额外任务. 然而,我们的方法只在部署之前支付一次验证费用。 然后,每个在线决定只需要一个单一的前进,传递两个技能文本。 其他作品选择在一集中从图书馆读取哪些技能(Li等,2026a.). 相反,我们的方法决定了新的技能是否应该取代目前的技能。 附 录 C讨论代理记忆,学习技能作家,以及进一步的相关工作.

blocks.en: 5.1 Benchmarks
blocks.zh: 5.1 基准

blocks.en: We evaluate on four benchmarks and use their test sets for online evaluation. ALFWorld ( Shridhar et al., 2021 ) is a text-based household environment. An agent completes tasks such as finding, heating, or cleaning objects through text commands. Its tasks fall into six families, namely Pick, Look, Clean, Heat, Cool, and Pick2. We use its seen and unseen test splits with 140 and 134 tasks. ScienceWorld ( Wang et al., 2022 ) is a text-based environment for elementary science experiments. Each of its 30 task types forms a family. We draw at most 30 test tasks per type, which gives 651 test tasks. LiveCodeBench ( Jain et al., 2025 ) collects competitive programming problems over time. We use the 175 problems added in its sixth release as the test set. Codex with GPT-6.1-sol assigns each problem to one of nine algorithmic categories (Appendix A.1 ). These categories serve as families. WebShop ( Yao et al., 2022 ) simulates online shopping. An agent searches a store and buys a product that matches an instruction. Its five product categories serve as families, and we use its 500 test tasks.
blocks.zh: 我们评价四项基准,并使用其测试集进行在线评价。 ALFWorld(Shridhar等,2021年)是一个以文字为主的家庭环境. 代理人通过文本命令完成诸如查找、取暖或清理对象等任务。 它的任务属于六个家庭,即Pick、Look、Clean、Heat、Cool和Pick2。 我们利用它所见所闻和所见的试验分出140和134个任务。 ScienceWorld(Wang等,2022年)是基础科学实验的文字环境. 它的30个任务类型都组成了家庭. 我们每类最多抽取30个测试任务,这给651个测试任务. LiveCode Bench(Jain等,2025年)收集一段时间以来的竞争性编程问题. 我们用第六版中添加的175个问题作为测试套. 带有GPT-6.1-sol的代码将每个问题指定为九个算法类中的一个(Appendix A.1 . 这些类别是家庭。 WebShop (姚等,2022年)模拟网上购物. 代理搜索商店并购买符合指令的产品. 它的五个产品类别是家庭,我们利用它的500个测试任务。

blocks.en: 5.4 Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 5.4 执行细节

blocks.en: To build pairs with clear utility gaps, we sample skills from generators of different quality. Skills from different generators follow different distributions and cover different quality levels. We use Qwen3-4B ( Yang et al., 2025 ) as the generator. However, its skills are of limited quality. Its skills alone rarely form pairs with clear utility gaps. We therefore add a second source of skills. On ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, and WebShop, the second source is an expert generator. We train it from Qwen3-4B with GRPO on the training tasks. On LiveCodeBench, the second source is GPT-6.1-sol. The second source samples more high-quality skills. Together with the base skills, it yields pairs with clear utility gaps.
blocks.zh: 为了建立有明显公用事业缺口的对子,我们从质量不同的发电机中抽取技能。 不同发电机的技能遵循不同的分布并覆盖不同的质量水平. 我们使用Qwen3-4B(杨等,2025年)作为发电机. 然而,其技能质量有限。 其技能本身很少形成有明显效用差距的一对. 因此,我们增加了第二个技能来源。 在ALFWorld,ScienceWorld,和WebShop上,第二个来源是专家生成器. 我们从Qwen3 -4B训练它 与GPRO的训练任务。 在LiveCode Bench上,第二个来源是GPT-6.1-sol. 第二出源采样更高品质技能. 它与基础技能一起产生具有明显效用差距的对子.

blocks.en: All experiments run on a server with four NVIDIA H200 GPUs. The selector backbone stays frozen, and we train LoRA adapters ( Hu et al., 2022 ) on all attention and feed-forward projections. The adapters have rank 32 and scaling factor 64. We use AdamW with a learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} and a cosine schedule. We train for one epoch and use the final checkpoint. Appendix A.3 gives the remaining details.

blocks.zh: 6 实验结果

blocks.en: 6.1 Main Performance
blocks.zh: 6.1 主要业绩

blocks.en: Table 1 reports online success on ALFWorld. We train the selector once. We then evaluate the same selector with executors built on three backbones, namely Qwen3-4B, Qwen3-8B, and Qwen3-32B.
blocks.zh: 表1报告了ALFWorld网上的成功。 我们训练选手一次。 然后我们用三个主干线,即:Qune3-4B,Qune3-8B,和Qune3-32B,来评价同一个选择器.

blocks.en: Table 1: Online success rate (%, ↑ \uparrow ) on ALFWorld by task family for three executors. Each value is the mean of three runs. Bold marks the best value in each column for each executor.
blocks.zh: 表1:3名执行者按任务家族分列的ALFWorld在线成功率(%,%\ oparrow). 每个值是三次运行的平均值. 粗体标出每个执行器在每个列中的最佳值。

blocks.en: EvoGuard achieves the best overall success with every executor. With the 4B executor, it reaches 55.7% on seen and 62.4% on unseen tasks. The strongest baselines reach 44.8% and 51.2%. With the 8B executor, EvoGuard reaches 53.3% and 54.7%. The strongest baselines reach 44.3% and 48.3%. Averaged over these four settings, EvoGuard reaches 56.5%. Accept-All and the three LLM-Judge baselines all average about 45.5%. The executor alone averages 36.7%.
blocks.zh: EvoGuard在每一个执行人身上都取得了最佳的总体成功. 有了4B执行器,在可见的情况下达到55.7%,在看不见的任务上达到62.4%。 最强基线达到44.8%和51.2%。 随着8B的执行者,EvoGuard达到了53.3%和54.7%. 最强基线达到44.3%和48.3%。 EvoGuard在这四种情况下的平均比例达到56.5%。 全部接受和三个LLM-法官基线均平均约为45.5%。 单独执行人平均为36.7%.

blocks.en: No training label comes from Qwen3-32B. Its rows therefore test transfer to an unseen executor. EvoGuard reaches 66.7% on seen and 71.6% on unseen tasks. The strongest baselines reach 59.3% and 68.7%. The executor alone reaches 51.7% and 58.2%.
blocks.zh: 没有训练标签来自Quen3-32B. 因此,它的行测试向一个看不见的执行者转移。 EvoGuard在目击量上达到66.7%,在隐形任务上达到71.6%. 最强基线达到59.3%和68.7%. 仅执行人就达到51.7%和58.2%。

blocks.en: LLM-Judge (Logit) uses the same prompt and the same decision rule as EvoGuard . The comparison between the two thus isolates the effect of training. EvoGuard improves over LLM-Judge (Logit) by 6.4% to 16.9% in overall success.
blocks.zh: LLM-法官(Logit)使用与EvoGuard相同的即时和裁决规则。 因此,两者的比较孤立了培训的效果。 EvoGuard将LLM法官(Logit)的总体成功率提高了6.4%至16.9%。

blocks.en: The gains differ across task families. They are largest on families that need multi-step procedures. With the 4B executor on seen tasks, EvoGuard raises Heat from 10.4% without skills to 54.2%. It raises Cool from 1.3% to 37.3%. On Pick, every method already reaches at least 75%, which leaves little room for skills. On a few families, skills even hurt. On Pick2 with the 8B executor, the executor alone reaches 61.1% on seen tasks, while EvoGuard reaches 50.0%. On Heat with the 32B executor, the executor alone reaches 50.7% on unseen tasks, while EvoGuard reaches 33.3%. The selector can only choose among the rewrites it receives. It cannot repair a family where written skills do not help.
blocks.zh: 各任务家庭的收益各不相同。 对于需要多步骤程序的家庭来说,这些家庭数量最多。 EvoGuard将没有技能的热量从10.4%提高到54.2%。 将酷从1.3%提升到37.3%. 在选取时,每种方法都已经达到至少75%,这给技能留下了很小的空间. 对少数家庭来说,技能甚至会受到伤害。 在与 8B 执行器的 Pick2 上,仅执行器在所看到的任务上就达到了61.1%,而 EvoGuard 则达到了50.0%. 在用32B执行器加热时,执行器单独在隐形任务上达到50.7%,而EvoGuard则达到33.3%. 选择者只能在其收到的重写中选择. 它无法修复书面技能无济于事的家庭。

blocks.en: Table 2 reports how each method treats the rewrites. Almost all rewrites pass the format check. Only LLM-Judge and LLM-Judge (Think) see a few invalid ones. EvoGuard accepts only 42.3% and 43.2% of the valid rewrites. The LLM-Judge baselines accept 68.4% to 72.0%. The skill in use is also shorter under EvoGuard . It averages 361 to 371 tokens, against 528 to 567 tokens under Accept-All and the LLM-Judge baselines. Yet EvoGuard achieves the best overall success with these shorter skills. This reveals that EvoGuard tends to keep content that is general and useful, rather than content that is specific to individual cases.
blocks.zh: 表2报告每种方法如何处理重写。 几乎所有重写都通过格式检查. 只有LLM-法官和LLM-法官(思维)看到一些无效的。 EvoGuard只接受42.3%和43.2%的有效重写. LLM-法官基线接受68.4%至72.0%。 在EvoGuard下, 平均为361至371个信使,而根据 " Accept-All " 和 " LLM-法官 " 基线,则为528至567个信使。 然而,EvoGuard凭借这些较短的技能取得了最佳的总体成功。 这表明,EvoGuard倾向于保留一般和有用的内容,而不是针对具体案件的内容。

blocks.en: Table 2: Acceptance statistics of the runs in Table 1 . Valid is the share of rewrites that pass the format check (%). Accepted is the share of valid rewrites that are adopted (%). Tokens is the mean length of the skill in use.
blocks.zh: 表2: 表1所列各项工作的接受统计数字 有效性是重写中通过格式检查的比例 (%) 。 接受是被采纳的有效重写的比例 (%) 。 Tokens是使用中技能的中间长度.

blocks.en: 6.2 Performance on Other Benchmarks
blocks.zh: 6.2 其他基准的业绩

blocks.en: We also report results on ScienceWorld and LiveCodeBench in Table 3 .
blocks.zh: 我们还在表3中报告科学世界和LiveCode Bench的成果。

blocks.en: Table 3: Online results on ScienceWorld and LiveCodeBench (%). ScienceWorld reports the success rate and the mean score. LiveCodeBench reports the pass rate. Bold marks the best value in each column.
blocks.zh: 表3:科学世界和LiveCode Bench在线结果(%)。 科学 世界报道成功率和中分. LiveCode Bench报告通过率. 粗体标出每列中的最佳值.

blocks.en: EvoGuard reaches 15.3% success and a score of 27.3. Without skills, the executor reaches 10.2% and 20.6. The other methods that use skills reach between 9.4% and 10.8% success. None of them is clearly better than using no skill. Accept-All even falls below it.
blocks.zh: EvoGuard成功15.3%,得分27.3. 没有技能,执行人达到10.2%和20.6%. 其他使用技能的方法成功率在9.4%至10.8%之间。 显然,没有一个比不使用技能更好。 接受 -所有甚至跌落到它以下。

blocks.en: EvoGuard achieves the best pass rate of 28.4%. This is 2.3% higher than running without skills. In contrast, Accept-All and Random both drop slightly to 25.7%. The LLM-Judge baselines reach between 25.3% and 27.0%, which is close to running without skills.
blocks.zh: EvoGuard实现28.4%的最佳通过率. 这比没有技能的跑步高出2.3%。 相比之下,Accept-All和Random都略有下降至25.7%。 LLM-法官基线在25.3%至27.0%之间,接近无技能运行。

blocks.en: The two benchmarks show the same pattern. The other methods that use skills stay close to the executor without skills, and Accept-All falls below it on both benchmarks. These methods cannot evolve the skill in a stable way. Good rewrites are mixed with harmful ones, and the gains of the former are cancelled by the latter. EvoGuard filters out the harmful rewrites before they replace the current skill. The skill can therefore improve over the task stream instead of drifting. These results show that EvoGuard mitigates skill degradation during evolution, and that this benefit is not limited to ALFWorld.
blocks.zh: 这两个基准显示了同样的模式。 使用技能的其他方法与没有技能的执行者保持接近,接受-所有方法在两个基准上都低于它. 这些方法不能稳定地发展技能。 善重写与有害相混合,前者的收益被后者所取消. EvoGuard在替换当前技能之前会过滤出有害的重写. 因此,这种技能可以超越任务流而不是漂移。 这些结果显示,埃沃瓜德在进化过程中缓解了技能退化,而这种好处并不限于ALFWorld.

blocks.en: 6.3 Training Performance
blocks.zh: 6.3 培训业绩

blocks.en: Figure 3 tracks the selector during training. On validation pairs, the untrained Qwen3-4B reaches 48.2%. This is no better than chance, because it answers A for 72% of the prompts. Accuracy rises to 89.6% after 100 steps. It reaches 95.0% at the final step. Parent-child pairs match the comparison of the online loop. On these pairs, accuracy rises from 58.1% to 86.3%.
blocks.zh: 图3 培训期间跟踪选择器。 在验证对上,未经过训练的Quen3-4B达到48.2%. 这不比机会好,因为它回答A 72%的提示。 准确度在100步后上升到89.6%. 最后一步达到95.0%. 亲子对接匹配在线循环的比较. 在这些对子上,精度从58.1%上升到86.3%.

blocks.en: Figure 3: Selector accuracy during training on the training batches (Train), on validation pairs (Validation), and on parent-child validation pairs (Parent-child).
blocks.zh: 图3:培训批次(培训)、鉴定对次(Validation)和父母-子女鉴定对次(父母-子女)培训期间的选择精度。

blocks.en: 6.4 Position Stability
blocks.zh: 6.4 立场稳定

blocks.en: Pairwise LLM judges are known to suffer from position bias ( Wang et al., 2024b ; Zheng et al., 2023 ) . We test this bias on the validation pairs. For each pair, we swap the positions of the two skills and check whether the selector keeps the same skill. Figure 4 reports this agreement rate. The untrained LLM-Judge (Logit) agrees on only 55.6% of the pairs. This is close to the 50% of a random choice. The untrained backbone thus cannot judge reliably which of the two skills is better. Our training places the two skills in random order and optimizes the two label logits. This calibrates the logits and makes the decision nearly invariant to the order of the inputs. EvoGuard agrees on 98.3% of the pairs.
blocks.zh: Pairwise LLM法官已知有职位偏差(Wang等人,2024年b; 郑等,2023). 我们在验证对上测试这种偏差. 每对,我们互换两种技能的位置,检查选手是否保持同样的技能. 图4报告了这一协议费率。 未受过训练的LLM-法官(Logit)只同意55.6%的配对. 这接近随机选择的50%. 因此,未经培训的骨干无法可靠地判断这两种技能中哪一种更好。 我们的训练将两种技能按随机顺序排列,并优化了两种标签日志. 这会校正日志,使决定几乎与输入顺序不一致。 EvoGuard同意98.3%的配对.

blocks.en: Figure 4: Share of validation pairs for which the selector keeps the same skill after the two skills swap positions. The dashed line marks a random choice.
blocks.zh: 图4:选择者在两个技能互换位置后保留相同技能的验证对子份额. 虚线表示随机选择.

blocks.en: 6.5 Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 6.5 读取研究

blocks.en: Table 4 removes one component of the training data at a time. Both variants reduce the average success by more than 4%. w/o expert-written pool removes the expert-written skills from the pool. The pool then lacks high-quality skills, because the base generator writes skills of limited quality. These skills are also generated by the same backbone as the selector, so their distribution is close to that of the selector backbone itself. The resulting pairs are difficult to distinguish and provide only a weak training signal. w/o rejection sampling draws pairs at random and discards only ties. As a result, 44% of the training pairs differ by less than 10% in utility, and their labels are dominated by estimation noise. Rejection sampling retains only pairs with a clear utility gap, which allows the selector to learn the features that separate good skills from poor ones. Both components are thus needed to obtain informative training pairs.
blocks.zh: 表4一次删除培训数据的一个部分。 这两个变体平均成功率都下降了4%以上. w/o专家写字池将专家写字技能从池中去掉. 游泳池随后缺乏高品质的技能,因为基础生成器写作技术质量有限. 这些技能也是由与选择者相同的骨干所产生,因此其分布接近于选择者骨干本身. 由此产生的对子很难区分,只能提供弱的训练信号. w/o拒绝抽样随机抽取对子,弃子只抽取领带. 因此,44%的训练配对在功用上的差异小于10%,其标签以估计噪声为主. 拒绝采样只保留有明显功用差距的对子,这使得选取者能够学习将好技能与贫穷技能区分开来的特点. 因此,需要两个部分来获得信息化培训对口。

blocks.en: Table 4: Ablation study of EvoGuard , reported as overall online success (%).
blocks.zh: 表4:对EvoGuard的校正研究,据报告在线总体成功(%)。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: Online skill evolution lets a deployed agent improve its skill after every task. However, each rewrite is based on a single trajectory and can degrade the skill. Adopting every rewrite lets the skill drift, while validating every update is too costly. We propose EvoGuard , a pairwise skill selector for skill selection. We first build a dataset of skills with utility labels through iterative rollouts and skill rewriting. Each label is the empirical utility of the skill on a private test set. Rejection sampling then keeps high-confidence pairs with clear utility gaps as preference supervision. We cast the comparison between the current skill and the new one as pairwise preference learning. The selector takes only the logits of the two label tokens and renormalizes over them. It aligns this conditional distribution with the preference labels. At deployment, each decision needs a single forward pass and generates no tokens. Its cost and latency are therefore low. Experiments on two agent benchmarks and one code benchmark confirm the effectiveness of EvoGuard . On ALFWorld, it reaches 56.5% average success against 45.5% for adopting every rewrite. On ScienceWorld, it raises success from 10.2% to 15.3%. On LiveCodeBench, it achieves the best pass rate of 28.4%.
blocks.zh: 在线技能进化让部署的代理人在完成每一项任务后提高技能. 然而,每次重写都是基于单一的轨迹,可以降低技能. 采用每次重写都会让技能漂移,同时验证每次更新成本太高. 我们提议EvoGuard, 一个双向技能选择器 来选择技能。 我们首先通过迭代推出和技能重写,建立一套带有实用标签的技能数据集。 每个标签都是技能在私人测试集上的经验效用. 拒绝取样后保留高自信的对子,并有明显的效用缺口作为优惠监督. 我们把当前技能与新技能的比较视为双向偏好学习。 选取者只取两个标签符号的对数,然后在它们上重新正常化. 它将这种有条件的分发与首选标签相匹配. 在部署时,每个决定都需要一个单一的前进通道,不会产生任何符号. 因此,其成本和耐用性都很低。 关于两个剂基准和一个编码基准的实验证实了EvoGuard的有效性。 在ALFWorld上,平均成功率达到56.5%,而采用每次重写的成绩为45.5%. 在科学世界,它将成功率从10.2%提高到了15.3%。 在LiveCode Bench上,它实现了28.4%的最好通过率.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Our experiments cover text-based agent environments and one code generation benchmark. Extending EvoGuard to multimodal or embodied settings is left for future work. All executors come from one model family. Other model families may rank skills somewhat differently. Building and scoring the skill pool requires offline computation before deployment. This cost is paid once and is shared by all later decisions. We train one selector per benchmark. A single selector that transfers across domains would further reduce the setup cost. The selector compares the current skill with one new skill at a time. Richer update rules, such as keeping several versions or reverting to an earlier one, may bring further gains. Finally, the selector can only choose among the rewrites it receives. Its benefit is therefore smaller in settings where skills offer little help.
blocks.zh: 我们的实验涵盖了基于文本的代理环境和一个代码生成基准. 将EvoGuard扩展至多式或已体现的设置,留待未来工作处理。 所有执行者都来自一个模范家庭. 其他模范家庭对技能的排序可能有所不同。 建立和评分技能库需要在部署前进行离线计算。 这笔费用一次性支付,由以后所有决定分摊。 我们每个基准训练一名选手 一个跨领域的单一选择者可以进一步降低设置成本。 选择者一次将当前技能与一门新技能进行比较. 较丰富的更新规则,例如保留若干版本或恢复到较早的版本,可能带来进一步的收益。 最后,选择者只能在其收到的重写中选择. 因此,在技能无济于事的情况下,其好处较小。

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en: Our experiments use public benchmarks in simulated environments and model-generated trajectories. They involve no human subjects and no private user data. The selector is supervised by task success, which does not guarantee that a skill is safe outside these environments. A reusable skill may also carry incorrect instructions to later tasks. Real deployments should therefore add safety checks suited to their domain and keep a record of skill versions. We use all benchmarks and models in accordance with their licenses. Generative AI assisted with literature search and with drafting and editing this manuscript.
blocks.zh: 我们的实验在模拟环境和模型产生的轨迹中使用了公共基准. 它们不涉及人类主体和私人用户数据。 选择者受任务成功监督,这并不能保证一种技能在这些环境之外是安全的. 可重复使用的技能也可能给以后的任务带来错误的指示. 因此,实际部署应增加适合其领域的安全检查并保存技能版本的记录。 我们根据其许可证使用所有基准和模式。 Generative AI协助了文献搜索,并起草和编辑了这本手稿.

blocks.en: Appendix A Additional Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 附录A 其他执行细节

blocks.en: This appendix gives the problem categories of LiveCodeBench, the prompts, the training of the selector, its use at inference, and the full online loop.
blocks.zh: 本附录给出了LiveCode Bench的问题类别,提示,选取者的培训,推断使用,以及全在线循环.

blocks.en: A.1 LiveCodeBench Problem Categories
blocks.zh: A.1 LiveCode Bench 问题类别

blocks.en: LiveCodeBench provides no grouping of its problems into task families. We therefore group the problems by the kind of algorithm they need, so that problems of one category can share a skill. We use the 879 problems released up to version 5 that have sample tests as the training set and the 175 problems added in version 6 as the test set ( Jain et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: LiveCode Bench没有将其问题归为任务家庭。 因此,我们将问题按它们所需要的算法分类,这样一类问题就可以分享技能。 我们使用发布至第5版的879个问题,这些问题作为培训集的样本测试,第6版中添加的175个问题作为测试集(Jain等,2025年).

blocks.en: We label all 1,054 problems with GPT-6.1-sol through the Codex command-line interface. Every call runs in an empty directory with a read-only sandbox. The prompt starts with the instruction to answer from the given text only, to run no commands, and to reply with one JSON value. The model sees the title, the statement, and the starter code of a problem. The hidden tests are never shown to it. The training and the test problems go through the same procedure, which has two steps.
blocks.zh: 我们通过 Codex 命令行接口将GPT-6.1-sol的所有1,054个问题标出标签. 每一次呼叫都运行在一个空目录中,有一个只读的沙盒. 提示开始于指令只从给定的文本中回答,不运行命令,并以一个JSON值回答. 模型可以看到标题,语句,以及一个问题的启动码. 隐藏的测试从未向它展示. 培训和测试问题经过同样的程序,它有两个步骤。

blocks.en: In the first step, the model tags the problems in batches of 20. The prompt is followed by the problems:
blocks.zh: 第一步,模型在20个批次中标出问题. 紧接着是问题:

blocks.en: ⬇ Below are { N } competitive programming problems . For each one , name the algorithmic topics a solver needs for the intended solution : 1 to 3 short lower - case tags ( for example " dynamic programming ", " greedy ", " graph traversal ", " simulation "), the most specific that still describe a family of problems , and which one of them is the primary topic . Reply with a JSON array with one object per problem , in the same order : {" id ": "< problem id >", " tags ": ["< tag >", ...], " primary ": "< one of the tags >"}

blocks.en: A.3 Selector Training
blocks.zh: A.3 选择培训

blocks.en: The selector backbone is Qwen3-4B. We train LoRA adapters with rank 32, scaling factor 64, and no dropout on all attention and feed-forward projections. We optimize with AdamW at a learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} and without weight decay. The learning rate warms up linearly over the first 3% of training and then follows a cosine decay. Gradients are clipped at norm 1.0. On ALFWorld, the private test set ℋ f \mathcal{H}_{f} of each family holds 100 tasks. The rejection threshold in Eq. ( 8 ) is δ = 0.1 \delta=0.1 , so the two skills of a pair differ by at least 10% in success rate. Each batch holds 36 pairs, six from every family, and training makes one pass over the 24,000 training pairs. We use the final checkpoint. The validation skills serve for reporting only. They are not used to select a checkpoint or to tune hyperparameters. The backbone runs in BF16 with FlashAttention-2. The adapter weights, the label-token logits, the loss, and the optimizer states are kept in FP32.

blocks.en: At deployment, we merge the trained adapter into the backbone and serve the merged model. For each query, the server returns the log-probabilities of the two label tokens at the next position. Both values share the same normalization term. Comparing them is therefore equivalent to comparing the logits z A z_{A} and z B z_{B} in Eq. ( 11 ).

blocks.en: Table 5 reports the online results on WebShop. The selector is trained with Qwen3-4B as the executor, and the Qwen3-8B columns change only the online executor. blocks.en: B.2 Combination with Other Methods

blocks.en: EvoGuard only decides which of two skill documents to keep. It can therefore be attached to other skill evolution methods without further training. We attach it to SkillRise ( Yao et al., 2026 ) , which trains one policy both to solve tasks and to curate the skill document. SkillRise keeps every curated document. With EvoGuard , the selector instead chooses between the old document and the curated one. The selector and its prompt are unchanged.
blocks.zh: EvoGuard只决定两个技能文档中哪一个保存. 因此,可以不经过进一步培训而附属于其他技能演变方法。 我们把它附在SkillRise(姚等,2026年)上,它训练一种政策,既要解决任务,又要管理技能文件. SkillRise保存每份被整理的文件. 由EvoGuard 来选择旧文档和编译文档。 选取者及其快取不变.

blocks.en: Appendix C Additional Related Work
blocks.zh: 附录C 相关工作

blocks.en: Beyond SkillRL and SkillRise, further methods combine policy learning with the construction or revision of a skill library ( Huang et al., 2026 ; Shi et al., 2026 ; Ge et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026c ; Wang et al., 2026c ) . Other methods keep the executor fixed and revise the skill text through prompted optimization ( Li and Hu, 2026 ; Ni et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026a ; Wang et al., 2026b ) . These methods focus on how a skill is produced or improved. However, our method does not change how skills are written. It only decides whether a rewrite replaces the current skill.
blocks.zh: 在SkillRL和SkillRise之外,进一步的方法将政策学习与技能库的建设或修订结合起来(黄等,2026;史等,2026;革等,2026;张等,2026c;王等,2026c). 其他方法通过激励优化使执行者固定并修改技能文本(李和胡,2026;倪等,2026;张等,2026a;王等,2026b.). 这些方法侧重于如何产生或改进技能。 然而,我们的方法并不改变技能的写作方式。 它只决定重写是否取代了当前技能.

blocks.en: LATM separates tool making from tool use ( Cai et al., 2024 ) . A line of work constructs and reuses skills in different settings ( Zheng et al., 2025 ; Yu et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026c ; Jiang et al., 2026a ; Wang et al., 2026a ; Qiu et al., 2026 ; Si et al., 2026 ) . Several surveys organize the area ( Zhou et al., 2026b ; Jiang et al., 2026b ; Jiang et al., 2025 ) . SkillsBench and SkillGenBench benchmark the effect of skills and of skill generation pipelines ( Li et al., 2026b ; Zhou et al., 2026a ) . An empirical study documents failures induced by skills ( Dong et al., 2026 ) . These works construct or benchmark skills and show that a plausible skill can still hurt execution. However, our method uses the measured utility of skills as supervision for a selector that guards every online update.
blocks.zh: LATM将工具制作与工具使用区分开来(Cai等,2024.). 不同场合的一行工作构建和再利用技能(郑等,2025;于等,2026;杨等,2026c;江等,2026a;王等,2026a;邱等,2026;西等,2026.). 有几次调查组织该地区(周等,2026b;江等,2026b;江等,2025). 技能. 法官座席和SkillGen Bench对技能和技能生成管道的影响的基准(Li等,2026b;Zhou等,2026a.) 一项实证研究记录了由技能引起的失败(Dong等,2026.). 这些作品构建或基准技能,并表明一种可能的技能仍然会伤害执行。 然而,我们的方法利用技术的实用性来监督一个选择者,他守护着每一次在线更新。

blocks.en: Skill- α \alpha , SkillOS, and SKILLER learn or prompt the writer of the skill with feedback from a frozen executor ( Shen et al., 2026 ; Ouyang et al., 2026a ; Dang et al., 2026 ) . SkillMaster uses a counterfactual probe to decide which edits to retain during training ( Yang et al., 2026a ) . Other work learns when to invoke a skill or to which skill a query is routed ( Guo et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026d ) . These methods shape how a skill is written or choose among the skills of a library. However, our method decides whether one rewrite replaces its predecessor.
blocks.zh: Skill -- -- α-alpha、SkillOS和SKILLER利用被冻结的执行人的反馈来学习或激励技能作者(沈等,2026;欧阳等,2026a; Dang等, 2026 (英语). 技能 Master使用反事实探测器决定哪些编辑在训练期间保留(Yang等,2026a.). 其他工作学习何时引用技能,或查询到哪个技能(郭等,2026;陈等,2026;王等,2026d.). 这些方法塑造了一种技能如何被书写或者在图书馆的技能中选择. 然而,我们的方法决定了重写是否取代前作。

blocks.en: SKILL0 withdraws contextual skills during reinforcement learning to internalize their behavior ( Lu et al., 2026 ) . Skill0.5 uses privileged distillation ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) . Context distillation trains a model to reproduce its prompted behavior without the prompt ( Snell et al., 2022 ; Ye et al., 2026 ) . These methods move guidance into model parameters. However, our method keeps the skill as text and leaves the executor unchanged.
blocks.zh: SKILL0在强化学习期间退出了上下文技能来内化他们的行为(Lu等,2026年). Skill0.5使用特权分馏(Zhu等,2026年). 上下文分馏会训练一种模型,以复制其激发的行为,而无需及时(Snell等,2022;Ye等,2026)。 这些方法将导入模型参数. 然而,我们的方法保持了作为文字的技巧,使执行者不变.

blocks.en: Reflexion uses verbal feedback to improve subsequent attempts ( Shinn et al., 2023 ) . ExpeL extracts insights from past trajectories ( Zhao et al., 2024 ) . Agent Workflow Memory stores reusable workflows ( Wang et al., 2025 ) . ReasoningBank organizes experience as reasoning memory ( Ouyang et al., 2026b ) , and Buffer of Thoughts keeps reusable thought templates ( Yang et al., 2024 ) . ACE treats context as an evolving resource ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) . Training-Free GRPO and Metacognitive Reuse improve contextual guidance without updating model parameters ( Cai et al., 2025 ; Didolkar et al., 2025 ) . Evo-Memory evaluates evolving memory in sequential task streams ( Wei et al., 2025 ) . These methods retrieve, accumulate, or consolidate general memory. However, our method keeps one skill document per task family and only decides between the current skill and one new skill.

ACE将上下文视为不断发展的资源(张等,2026b.). 培训-免费GRPO和元数据 在不更新模型参数的情况下,重新使用改进了背景指导(Cai等人,2025;Didolkar等人,2025)。 Evo-Memory评价相继任务流中不断发展的内存(Wei等,2025年). 这些方法可以检索,积累,或巩固一般记忆. 然而,我们的方法保存着每个任务家庭一份技能文件,只决定当前技能与一种新技能。
